invariants: isbn must be unique across all records
title must not be empty or whitespace-only
publisher must not be empty or whitespace-only
publication_year must be a valid year (e.g., between 1800 and current year)
price must be a positive number
genre must be a non-empty string
author_name must not be empty or whitespace-only
copies_ordered must be a non-negative integer
copies_received must be a non-negative integer
copies_available must be equal to (copies_received - copies_ordered)
